recipe.name: Greek Yoghurt Bowl with Walnuts, Pumpkin Seeds and Berries
instructions: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl.
Whisk in the whey protein isolate until smooth.
Top with walnuts, pumpkin seeds and blueberries.
Dust with cinnamon and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Grilled Chicken and White Bean Salad with Feta
instructions: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper, then grill or pan-sear over medium-high heat 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Let chicken rest 5 minutes, then slice.
In a large bowl, combine lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, cannellini beans and red onion.
Whisk olive oil, red wine vinegar and oregano together and toss with the salad.
Top salad with sliced chicken and crumbled feta, then serve.

recipe.name: Mexican Grilled Skirt Steak Tacos with Charred Corn and Peppers
instructions: Rub skirt steak with garlic, cumin, chili powder, salt and half the lime juice; let sit 10 minutes at room temperature.
Heat a grill pan or skillet over high heat with half the avocado oil; sear steak 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, then rest and slice thinly against the grain.
In the same pan with remaining oil, char the poblano and onion slices for 5-6 minutes until softened and lightly blackened at edges.
Warm corn tortillas directly over the flame or in a dry pan until pliable and lightly toasted.
Assemble tacos with sliced steak, charred peppers and onions, avocado slices and cilantro.
Finish with remaining lime juice and serve immediately.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Peppered Mackerel with Lemon and Cucumber
instructions: Flake the smoked mackerel fillet onto a plate, removing any bones.
Slice the cucumber thinly and arrange alongside the fish.
Squeeze lemon juice over the mackerel and cucumber.
Sprinkle with fresh dill and black pepper.
Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Tandoori-Style Roast Chicken Thighs with Spiced Cauliflower and Spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C (fan) with a roasting tray inside.
Mix yogurt, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, turmeric and lemon juice into a tandoori-style marinade.
Coat chicken thighs thoroughly in the marinade.
Toss cauliflower florets with half the ghee and place on the hot tray with the marinated chicken thighs.
Roast for 20 minutes, turning once, until chicken is cooked through and cauliflower is charred at the edges.
In the last 3 minutes, wilt spinach in a hot pan with remaining ghee.
Plate the roasted chicken with cauliflower and spinach and serve hot.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Smoky White Bean and Turkey Bacon Baked Beans
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook diced onion and garlic until softened.
Add chopped turkey bacon and cook until slightly crisp.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, smoked paprika, and Dijon mustard; simmer 3 minutes.
Add white beans and simmer gently for 10 minutes, mashing a few beans to thicken the sauce.
In a separate small pan, fry the egg to desired doneness.
Spoon the baked beans into a bowl, top with the fried egg and chopped parsley, and serve hot.

recipe.name: Thai Braised Pork Belly with Star Anise and Kaffir Lime
instructions: In a heavy pot, sear pork belly cubes over medium-high heat until browned on all sides.
Add garlic, shallot, galangal, and star anise; stir-fry 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in fish sauce, coconut aminos, and palm sugar, coating the pork evenly.
Pour in chicken stock and add kaffir lime leaves; bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise on low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until pork is tender and sauce thickens.
Add tofu cubes and bok choy in the last 5 minutes of cooking, simmering until greens wilt.
Let the braise rest off heat for a few minutes to deepen flavor before serving.
Garnish with sliced Thai chili and chopped cilantro, then serve hot.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: High-Protein Egg White Scramble with Spinach and Cottage Cheese
instructions: Finely dice the red onion and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and sauté onion for 2 minutes until softened.
Add spinach and cherry tomatoes, cook for 2 minutes until spinach wilts.
Whisk egg whites and whole egg together with salt and pepper, pour into the skillet.
Gently scramble the eggs over medium-low heat until just set, about 3-4 minutes.
Fold in cottage cheese and cook for another minute until warmed through.
Garnish with chopped chives and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Japanese Chicken Katsu-Style Curry with Steamed Rice
instructions: Cut chicken tenderloin into bite-sized pieces and slice onion and carrot thinly.
Heat sesame oil in a saucepan over medium heat, sauté onion, garlic and ginger until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add chicken pieces and sear for 2-3 minutes until lightly browned.
Add carrot, chicken stock, soy sauce and mirin, bring to a simmer.
Stir in curry powder and simmer uncovered for 10-12 minutes until chicken is cooked through and carrots are tender.
Mix arrowroot starch with a splash of cold water to form a slurry, stir into the curry and cook 2 minutes until thickened.
Serve the curry over steamed white rice and garnish with sliced scallion.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Vanilla Almond Butter Protein Shake
instructions: Add almond milk, protein powder, almond butter, heavy cream, ice, and cinnamon to a blender.
Blend on high for 45-60 seconds until smooth and frothy.
Pour into a glass and drink immediately.

recipe.name: Greek One-Pan Lemon Sardine and Feta Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F) and line a baking tray.
Toss zucchini and cherry tomatoes with half the olive oil, minced garlic, oregano, and salt; spread on the tray.
Roast vegetables for 8 minutes to soften slightly.
Push vegetables to one side, arrange butterflied sardines skin-down on the tray, and drizzle remaining olive oil and lemon juice over the fish.
Scatter crumbled feta and olives over the sardines and vegetables.
Bake for another 10-12 minutes until sardines are cooked through and feta is lightly golden.
Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Greek Yoghurt with Toasted Walnuts, Pumpkin Seeds and Raspberries
instructions: Toast the walnuts and pumpkin seeds in a dry pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until fragrant, stirring frequently.
Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with the raspberries, toasted walnuts and pumpkin seeds.
Dust with cinnamon and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Korean Beef Bulgogi-Style Stir Fry with Napa Cabbage and Mushrooms
instructions: Combine soy sauce, honey, gochujang, half the garlic and half the ginger in a bowl. Marinate the sliced beef in this mixture for 15 minutes.
Cook the rice separately if not using pre-cooked rice; set aside.
Heat sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until shimmering.
Add the marinated beef and stir-fry for 2 minutes until just browned, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining garlic and ginger to the wok, stir-fry 30 seconds, then add carrot and mushrooms, stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add napa cabbage and stir-fry another 2 minutes until just wilted.
Return beef to the wok, toss everything together for 1 minute to combine and heat through.
Stir in spring onion and remove from heat.
Serve over the cooked rice, sprinkled with toasted sesame seeds.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Smoked Mackerel with Soft Scrambled Eggs and Chives
instructions: Halve the cherry tomatoes and sear them in a dry pan for 2-3 minutes until slightly blistered; set aside.
Melt butter in a nonstick pan over low heat.
Whisk eggs lightly and pour into the pan, stirring constantly over low heat until softly set and creamy, about 3-4 minutes.
Warm the smoked mackerel gently in the oven or a dry pan for 2-3 minutes.
Plate the scrambled eggs with the mackerel and blistered tomatoes.
Squeeze lemon juice over the mackerel, sprinkle with chives and black pepper, and serve.

recipe.name: Middle Eastern Grilled Lamb Chops with Charred Zucchini and Tahini Sauce
instructions: Pat lamb chops dry and rub with half the garlic, cumin, sumac, salt, and 5g olive oil. Let marinate 20-30 minutes at room temperature.
Slice zucchini lengthwise into thick planks, toss with remaining olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Heat a grill or grill pan over high heat; sear lamb chops 3-4 minutes per side for medium, then rest 5 minutes.
Grill zucchini planks alongside for 3-4 minutes per side until charred and tender.
Whisk tahini with remaining garlic, lemon juice, and a splash of water until smooth and pourable to make the sauce.
Plate the lamb chops with charred zucchini, drizzle tahini sauce over both, and garnish with chopped parsley.
